Uttaranchal Dental College Admission: Uttaranchal Dental College seats are filled on the basis of NEET results and state counselling sessions. Let’s look into the details of the admission procedure.
Admission Procedure: The following are the admission Procedure for Uttaranchal Dental College Dehradun.
Pass the NEET Entrance Exam: Candidates must pass the NEET UG entrance exam for undergraduate dental courses and the NEET PG entrance exam for postgraduate dental courses. Adequate preparation and understanding of the NEET syllabus are crucial for achieving a qualifying score.
Participate in Uttarakhand NEET Counseli: Admission to Uttaranchal Dental College is facilitated through the Uttarakhand NEET Counseling process. Candidates should ensure they register and participate in this counseling session to secure a seat at the college.
Download and Complete the Application Fo: Visit the official website of Uttaranchal Dental and Medical Research Institute to download the application form. Carefully complete the form with accurate personal and academic information. Ensure that all sections of the form are filled out correctly.
Submit the Application Form and Required: Submit the completed application form along with all required documents to the admission department of Uttaranchal Dental and Medical Research Institute. Essential documents typically include identity proof, NEET scorecard, academic transcripts, and other relevant certifications. Verify that all documents are in order to prevent any delays in the processing of your application.
Await the Uttaranchal NEET Merit List: After submission, candidates must wait for the release of the Uttaranchal NEET merit list. This list determines the ranking of candidates based on their NEET scores. The college will notify candidates about their admission status based on their position in the merit list.
BDS Eligibility Criteria: They must appear for NEET to be eligible for admission.
Only Indian citizens are qualified to apply.
Candidate must have passed 10+2 from a prestigious institution.
Candidate must possess 50% marks separately in Biology. Furthermore, they should have 50% in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
17 years old on or before December 31st of the year of application.
MDS Eligibility Criteria: The candidate must have passed the NEET exam for MDS.
The candidate must have a Dental Council of India Registration Certificate.
The candidate must have a BDS degree from a recognized university.
Before being admitted to BDS, candidates must have completed one year of internship.
Documents Required (2): Registration certificate under the State Dental Council.
Uttaranchal Dental College Dehradun Fee: Students have various expenses, such as living expenses, travel expenses, and stationery expenses, so they should be aware of the overall fee structure of any course that they wish to enroll in. We have provided simplified and detailed information about the Uttaranchal Dental College Fee Structure , which includes all departments and specializations.
Placements and Scope: Uttaranchal Dental College has been in operation since 2006 and has extensive experience in preparing students to face the various challenges that await them in the field of dentistry. Our alumni have also created numerous job opportunities through their talent and the assistance of our highly qualified faculty. Students who have completed their BDS or MDS at the Uttaranchal Dental and Medical Research Institute have been placed in a variety of prestigious government and private dental hospitals.
Career Oppurtunities after BDS: Many of our students are hired at Uttaranchal Hospital, which is part of our college, and they serve the patients with great dedication and determination while earning good pay. Students have the following career opportunities after BDS.
Academic Institutions for Dental Consultant Research
Ranking and Recognitions: Uttaranchal Dental College’s outstanding efforts in providing excellence in academics as well as overall student development have contributed to its increased social recognition. The college has received numerous awards, and its organization of free dental camps with excellent facilities has elevated it above all other dental institutions.
The Uttaranchal Dental College is recognized and approved by the government of India and the Dental Council of India.
At interstate competitions, students from the college have excelled in academics and other co-curricular activities.
The college has organized many awareness camps for patients’ oral hygiene and oral dental care, earning it widespread acclaim in the community.
On- Campus Facilities Offered: Uttaranchal Dental College offers best facilities and infrastructure such as:
Contact Details: Address: Mazri Grant, NH-72, Haridwar Road, Near Doiwala, Dehradun – 248140, Uttarakhand, India.
If you are in search of dental colleges in Uttarakhand, you can go through the detailed post on Seema Dental College Rishikesh .
Is there an internship program at Uttara: Yes, the college offers internships to students who have completed a four-year BDS degree program. Furthermore, the college provides a stipend to students during the internship period.
What is Uttaranchal Dental College Dehra: The number of seats available for BDS is 100 per academic year, while the number of seats available for MDS is 9 per academic year, including all specializations.
Which university is Uttaranchal Dental C: Uttaranchal Dental College Dehradun is affiliated with the Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna University in Srinagar, Garhwal, and Uttarakhand.
Is there a hospital attached to the Utta: To serve the patients, the college has a hospital named Uttaranchal Hospital, which has a fully functional OPD and a large patient inflow daily, as well as well-equipped clinical labs and many other amenities.
How many specializations are available f: Uttaranchal Dental College offers a total of five specializations for the Master of Dental Surgery degree.
What are the various career options avai: After BDS, you can pursue a Master of Dental Surgery, practice dentistry, or work in a government dental hospital, among other options.
What is Uttaranchal Dental College fee s: Uttaranchal Dental College fee structure for BDS is INR 2,15,000/-.
Uttaranchal Dental College fee structure for MDS is INR 4,00,000/- to INR 7,09,000/- per year.
Is Uttaranchal Dental College approved b: Yes, Uttaranchal Dental College is approved by Dental Council of India.
